half_1_stray_computer_text.why: The Deck was handed back to the maintainer before this half could be set up. It needs Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor running, Speed, voice on, and the three power questions.

half_2_panel_naming_a_closed_game.setup: Hades running, panel open, then Hades exited through the Steam menu
measured: Immediately after the exit, the line under the question box read 'Context: active game AppID 1145360'.
Still the same after 31 seconds of polling every 2 seconds.
Still the same about four minutes later.
Still the same after closing the Quick Access Menu with the chord and reopening it.
half_2_panel_naming_a_closed_game.expected: 'Context: no active game detected' within a few seconds of exiting.
half_2_panel_naming_a_closed_game.where: src/components/MainTab.tsx:279-294 renders the line from props.ollamaContext: 'Context: active game AppID <id>' when app_context is 'active', otherwise 'Context: no active game detected'. The element is .bonsai-context-footnote in the main tab dock at y=751, so this is the live line, not a record of the finished turn.
half_2_panel_naming_a_closed_game.why_it_matters: Commit 3158835 fixed this for the reopen path and its message says the ordinary keep-in-sync check corrects itself in about a second and a half. Neither held here: the panel stayed open across the exit and never corrected, and a full close-and-reopen of the Quick Access Menu did not correct it either.
half_2_panel_naming_a_closed_game.caveat: The line names the game by its AppID, not by its name, so a reader may not recognise which game it means. The failure is that it still points at a game that is closed.

verdict: FAIL on the half that was run; the other half is still owed.
